notes.title: Graphics Settings & Key Bindings - Version 1.0.3
notes.content:
Yo! We have now added lots of graphics settings and customizable key bindings. Hopefully, this should make the game playable on more devices! We have also renamed the areas of the ship and reworked the research area to make it easier to navigate. Beware that you may have to readjust your settings or start a new save because of the changes! You can read more below in the full list of changes. Next up, we will improve the AI. 

[b]Settings[/b]
[list]
[*] Added graphics settings for texture quality, shadow quality, reflection quality, global illumination quality, and anti-aliasing quality.
[*] Added remappable key bindings to the settings menu. Also changed the [i]Shoot EMP[/i] default mapping to [i]Left Mouse Click[/i] and removed all alternative mappings for all actions so they don’t conflict with the remapping.
[*] Removed the old brightness settings and replaced them fully with the gamma brightness setting. You may need to readjust brightness if you have changed the old settings.
[*] Lowered the default sensitivity. You may have to readjust.
[/list]
[b]Gameplay and Level[/b]
[list]
[*] Renamed ship areas to make them less confusing and harder to mix up.
[*] Removed the vent control room, moved its terminal into research, and deleted its recharge station. We also reworked some covers within research and moved the terminal into research.  Additionally, we also added one more keycard and clearance level. If you have an ongoing save, you might get stuck because of the additional clearance level or the moved terminal. If so, you will have to start a new game.
[*] The clearance level icons stay on the map when you override.
[/list]
[b]Other Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Corrected spelling and grammar in 20+ logs.
[*] Resolved a bug where the mouse cursor disappeared when you paused and unpaused the game while using a terminal.
[/list]
Hope you enjoy the changes! If you couldn't play the game before due to key bindings or graphics, let us know what you think of it! <3

//Jakob from the Dev Team

notes.title: Updates Based on Player Feedback - Version 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hey hey! Here’s an update with more changes. Most of them are based on player feedback, thanks a lot! <3 We have also added some more polish, scripted events, and other improvements. Next up, we’ll look into some graphics settings to improve performance on lower-end hardware. Here’s a list of the changes:

[b]Gameplay & Levels[/b]
[list]
[*] Made data terminals safe per default. When you use them, all enemies stop moving. You can toggle this on and off with the “Safe Data Terminals” setting. Note that this won’t stop the timer used for achievements and that enemies’ aggression levels won’t cool down while you’re using the terminal.
[*] We added a scripted event in the gym that will hopefully resolve confusion about backtracking (some players didn’t think they could get past the moths and went back to where they came from).
[*] Added a scripted surprise as well as some more cocoons around the ship. Also fixed the material for the cocoons that weren’t visible in heat vision.
[*] The big monster kill-cam/jumpscare is more zoomed in.
[*] Added a helpful prompt that appears after a while for players struggling with opening the first door.
[*] Heat vision now costs a little bit of battery to turn on (to nerf the "spam E" strategy).
[*] Moved the recharge station within the servers area and added one to the gym.
[*] Added crouch prompts at obstacles since some players missed that you could go under them.
[/list]
[b]Settings[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a Gamma setting for easier brightness adjustments but kept the old Brightness and Contrast settings for additional tweaking.
[*] All sounds should now be controlled by the correct sound settings sliders.
[/list]
[b]Sound[/b]
[list]
[*] Monsters roar when you step into the light and moths buzz around the lamp. Also added more variation to the monster’s roar when it kills you.
[*] Improved sound attenuation and tweaked many of the sounds.
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a VSync issue.
[*] Resolved a bug where the moths deal double damage.
[*] Fixed a spelling mistake in a log. Players have read about 4000 read logs so it does make you a bit self-conscious xD
[/list]
FYI, the update may cause conflicts with the save system. If you experience any weird bugs, try starting a new game!

Hope you enjoy the changes! :D

//Jakob from the Dev Team

notes.title: Day One Patch - Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Woop! Woop! We resolved our issues with the Steamworks account management and were finally able to push the Day One Patch to everyone!! :D

After looking at player data and feedback during the first 24 hours, we quickly put together the following changes:
- The monsters' aggression levels have been lowered and now cool down over time if you don't go into more lights or agitate them.
- Moths have been nerfed.
- Cryogenics timer setup has been completely reworked.
- Two new speaker broadcasts have been added to help with direction and immersion.
- The monsters don't get stuck in the ventilation to server room doorway.
- Crouch is now bound to both [i]Ctrl [/i]and [i]C[/i].
- V-sync setting added.
- "Speed Runner" achievement should work again.
- The broadcast in Engineering should only trigger when you first enter the Ship Hub and not on your way back.

Also, as we mentioned in the Beta branch announcement, we still have some issues with the Steam backend and have an open support ticket. Until that gets resolved, some of the achievements may not trigger or trigger incorrectly. These include: "Lore Freak" triggering too early, and "Pro Gamer" and "Better Safe Than Sorry" not triggering at all.

For those requesting customizable key bindings, we're working on it but we'll need to fix some other things first. Thanks for your patience! <3 On another note, while the game doesn't support Gamepad Controls for menus and data terminals yet, we have implemented it for the rest of the game interactions.

Thanks for all the feedback and engagement so far! If you have played the game already, let us know what you think about the changes! :)

We hope you look forward to more updates! <3

Love,
Jakob from the Dev Team

notes.title: Day One Patch Available in Beta Branch
notes.content:

Nonetheless, we have still published the changes on the [b]Beta branch[/b] and made it accessible to everyone. To try them out, right-click on the game in your library, select [i]Properties[/i] and then [i]Betas[/i], and select "beta" in the list. Hope you enjoy them! Let us know what you think!

Have a nice weekend and dream sweet lightmares tonight! <3
